title: turn.progress (server -> device)
description: Draft. A step of the accepted turn started. Sent only when session.open had features.turn_progress 1, after the turn's turn.accepted and before its first output.start. seq starts at 1 for each turn and increases by one per message. label is display text chosen by the server from a fixed list; it never carries a tool name, tool arguments or the transcript. Not a keep-alive.
